en: The Albert Helmanbrug (bridge 1231) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge connects the Anton de Komplein with the Nelson Mandelapark. en: Aldo van Eyckbrug (bridge 413) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The Stadionplein lies at its north-east end.

name: Aldo van Eyckbrug

The four-lane traffic bridge with bicycle and pedestrian paths on both sides, over which tram line 24 also runs, is located on Amstelveenseweg. It spans the Zuider Amstel Canal here, where it flows into the Stadiongracht. On the northeast side of the bridge is Stadionplein.

en: Berta de Vriesbrug (bridge 128) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge, over which no public transport runs, connects Westerstraat with Marnixplein and spans the Lijnbaansgracht.

en: Berta de Vriesbrug (bridge 128) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge, which carries no public transport, connects the Westerstraat with the Marnixplein and spans the Lijnbaansgracht. Several municipal monuments stand around it.

name: Beudekerbrug
en: The Beudekerbrug (bridge 122) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the north-eastern quay of the Prinsengracht and spans the Leidsegracht in Amsterdam's canal ring. With the Angenietje Swarthofbrug and the Pieter Goemansbrug it forms a crossing over the Leidsegracht and Prinsengracht, surrounded by national monuments.

name: Beudekerbrug
en: The Beudekerbrug (bridge 122) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the northeastern quay of the Prinsengracht. It spans the Leidsegracht in the canal belt of Amsterdam. The bridge forms a junction over the Leidse and Prinsengracht with the Angenietje Swarthof Bridge and the Pieter Goemans Bridge.

en: The Bevrijdingslinde van de Jordaankinderen is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. en: Brug 11 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the western quay of the Singel and spans the Blauwburgwal. Both bridges have been here for centuries; Pieter Bast drew them both on his 1599 map of the city.

en: Brug 117 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge lies in the Rozengracht and spans the Lijnbaansgracht. name: Brug 117

name: Brug 118
en: Brug 118 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the northern quay of the Bloemgracht, spans the Lijnbaansgracht and leads to the Marnixstraat. A stone's throw away lie bridge 119 and the Bullebakssluis, both over the Bloemgracht. A bridge has been here for centuries; it is already drawn on Joan Blaeu's map of 1649.

name: Brug 119
en: Brug 119 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge lies in the eastern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and spans the Bloemgracht. Three bridges meet at this crossing of canals: this one, bridge 118 over the Lijnbaansgracht, and the Bullebakssluis over the extended Bloemgracht.

name: Brug 119

At this intersection of canals there are three bridges, this bridge, bridge 118 (over the Lijnbaansgracht) and the Bullebak sluice over the extended Bloemgracht.

name: Brug 126

name: Brug 142

A bridge has been here for centuries; Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode drew one on his map of 1625.

name: Brug 24
en: Brug 24 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Gasthuismolensteeg with the Hartenstraat, spanning the Herengracht. The bridge, not a monument itself, is surrounded by municipal and national monuments. A bridge has been here for centuries: Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode drew one on his map of 1625.

name: Brug 24
en: Brug 24 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms the connection between Gasthuismolensteeg and Hartenstraat. It spans the Herengracht. The bridge, itself not a monument, is surrounded by municipal and national monuments. There has been a bridge here for centuries. name: Brug 331
en: Brug 331 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West over a cooling-water channel. Bridge 391, a railway bridge, lies about 10 metres to its north. Twenty metres further on lies the pairing of bridge 330 (road) and bridge 390 (rail) carrying the Nieuwe Hemweg over the same channel.

name: Brug 361
en: Brug 244 is a fixed bridge in Westpoort. The structure lies in the Nieuwe Hemweg and crosses the Tweede Koelwaterkanaal of the Centrale Hemweg. It was designed at the same time as bridge 361 further along the Nieuwe Hemweg, which is why the two look the same. It carries a two-lane road for fast traffic and a two-lane cycle path.

name: Brug 38
en: Brug 38 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Brug 388
en: Brug 275 is a fixed railway bridge in Westpoort, Amsterdam. The bridge with a single track crosses the mouth of the Second Cool Water Canal into the Central Hemweg. name: Brug 388
en: Brug 275 is a fixed railway bridge in Westpoort, Amsterdam. The single-track bridge crosses the mouth of the Tweede Koelwaterkanaal at the Centrale Hemweg. It dates from the mid-1970s and was designed by Sier van Rhijn, later responsible for the buildings of the Amsterdam metro's Oostlijn. The bridge has a concrete span.

name: Brug 39
en: Brug 39 is a bridge in the northern quay of the Keizersgracht over the Reguliersgracht in Amsterdam's canal ring. It has a navigable opening 6.80 metres wide with a clearance of 2.38 metres. There were several plans to fill in the Reguliersgracht, but none were ever carried out.

name: Brug 390
en: Brug 390 is a fixed bridge in Westpoort, Amsterdam. It is a railway bridge laid over the cooling-water channel of the Centrale Hemweg, parallel to the road bridges numbered 330. Like bridge 330 it has three openings, but shipping of any kind is impossible here: the current is strong and the bridges lie low.

name: Brug 390
en: Brug 390 is a permanent bridge in Westpoort, Amsterdam. It is a railway bridge that was built over the cooling water canal of the Centrale Hemweg. It lies parallel to the traffic bridges numbered 330. Like bridge 330, the railway bridge has three passages, but shipping of any kind is impossible here. name: Brug 40
en: Brug 40 is a bridge in the southern quay of the Keizersgracht over the Reguliersgracht in Amsterdam's canal ring. It has a navigable opening 6.80 metres wide with a clearance of 2.38 metres. There were several plans to fill in the Reguliersgracht, but none were ever carried out.

name: Brug 42
en: Brug 42 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Nieuwe Spiegelstraat and spans the Keizersgracht. The bridge, not a monument itself, is surrounded by national monuments. A bridge has been here for centuries: city architect Daniël Stalpaert already drew one on the design part of his 1662 map.

name: Brug 42
en: Brug 42 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located in the Nieuwe Spiegelstraat and spans the Keizersgracht. The bridge, itself not a monument, is surrounded by national monuments. There has been a bridge here for centuries.

name: Brug 43
en: Brug 43 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge, over which trams 2 and 12 run in particular, is located in Leidsestraat and spans the Keizersgracht in the Amsterdam Canal Belt. There has been a bridge here for centuries.

name: Brug 43
en: Brug 43 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge, carrying tram lines 2 and 12 in particular, lies in the Leidsestraat and spans the Keizersgracht in Amsterdam's canal ring. A bridge has been here for centuries: city architect Daniël Stalpaert already drew it on his map of 1662.

name: Brug 46
en: Brug 46 (formerly Quellijn bridge) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum The bridge is located on the northern quay of the Leidsegracht and spans the Keizersgracht. Surrounding the bridge are buildings on all eight quays that have been designated as national monuments. The bridge itself could not be declared a monument, it is too young for that.

name: Brug 46
en: Brug 46, formerly the Quellijn brug, is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the northern quay of the Leidsegracht and spans the Keizersgracht. Buildings on all eight quays around the bridge are national monuments. The bridge itself could not be listed: it is too young for that.

name: Brug 47
en: Brug 47 is a welfare bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects Huidenstraat with Runstraat and crosses the Keizersgracht in the area of the Nine Streets in the Amsterdam canal belt. The bridge, due to its young age itself no monuments, is surrounded by national monuments, except on the southeast side, there is (relatively) new construction

name: Brug 47
en: Brug 47 is an arched bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Huidenstraat with the Runstraat, crossing the Keizersgracht in the Negen Straatjes area of Amsterdam's canal ring. Too young to be a monument itself, it is surrounded by national monuments except on the south-east side, where the building is relatively new.

name: Brug 51
en: Brug 51 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Brug 52
en: Brug 52 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge lies in the western quay of the Keizersgracht and spans the Leliegracht. Seen from the centre, the Leliesluis lies just beyond it. It is flanked by bridges 51, beside it, and 53, on the far side of the Keizersgracht.

name: Brug 52
en: Brug 52 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located on the western quay of the Keizersgracht and spans the Leliegracht. From the center viewed, the Leliesluis is located just behind this bridge. It is flanked by the bridges 51 (next to it) and 53 (across the Keizersgracht).

name: Brug 53
en: Brug 53 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge lies in the eastern quay of the Keizersgracht and spans the Leliegracht. It is flanked by bridges 51, beside it, and 52, on the far side of the Keizersgracht. Too young to be a monument itself, it is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Brug 53
en: Brug 53 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Keizersgracht and spans the Leliegracht. It is flanked by bridges 51 (next to it) and 52 (across the Keizersgracht). The bridge, itself not a monument (it is too young for that), is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Brug 56
en: Brug 56 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the eastern quay of the Keizersgracht with the Binnen Brouwersstraat, crossing the Brouwersgracht. A municipal monument since 1995, it is surrounded by national monuments and shares its south-western quay wall with the Pastoorsbrug.

name: Brug 56
en: Brug 56 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the eastern quay of the Keizersgracht with the Binnen Brouwersstraat. It crosses the Brouwersgracht. The bridge, a municipal monument since 1995, is surrounded by national monuments. The bridge shares its southwest quay wall with the Pastoorsbrug.

name: Brug 6
en: Brug 6 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the Paleisstraat with the Gasthuismolensteeg, spanning the Singel. The Bungehuis stands to its south-east.

name: Brug 66
en: Brug 66 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge lies in line with the Runstraat, heading out of the city, and crosses the Prinsengracht. Unlike the bridges north of it, this one does connect to a through traffic route, that of the northern quay of the Looiersgracht. The bridge is not a monument itself.

name: Brug 66
en: Brug 66 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located in the extension (city exit) of the Runstraat and crosses the Prinsengracht. name: Brug 69
en: Brug 69 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Spiegelgracht with the Nieuwe Spiegelstraat and crosses the Prinsengracht. The bridge is already drawn on Jacob Bosch's map of the Fourth Expansion of around 1679. In 1866 a tender was put out for a new bridge, which contractors could build for 20,000 guilders.

name: Brug 69
en: Brug 69 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects the Spiegelgracht with the Nieuwe Spiegelstraat and crosses the Prinsengracht. On Jacob Bosch's map with the Fourth explanation on it from around 1679, the bridge is already drawn.

name: Brug 707
en: Brug 707 is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Brug 72
en: Brug 72 and Brug 73 are two permanent bridges in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridges are located in the banks of the Prinsengracht and cross the Reguliersgracht. Bridge 73 is on the city side (north side, odd numbers), bridge 72 on the outside side (south side, even numbers). The bridges are surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Brug 73
en: Brug 72 and Brug 73 are two fixed bridges in Amsterdam-Centrum. They lie in the quays of the Prinsengracht and cross the Reguliersgracht. Bridge 73 is on the city side (north, odd numbers) and bridge 72 on the outer side (south, even numbers). Both are surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Brug 73
en: Brug 72 and Brug 73 are two permanent bridges in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridges are located in the banks of the Prinsengracht and cross the Reguliersgracht. Bridge 73 is on the city side (north side, odd numbers), bridge 72 on the outside side (south side, even numbers). The bridges are surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Brug 74
en: Brug 74 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Kerkstraat and spans the Reguliersgracht in Amsterdam's canal ring. A municipal monument since 1995, it is surrounded by national monuments, the best known of which is the Amstelkerk on the Amstelveld. A bridge has been here for centuries.

name: Brug 74
en: Brug 74 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located in Kerkstraat and spans the Reguliersgracht in the Amsterdam canal belt. The bridge, itself a municipal monument as of 1995, is surrounded by national monuments, of which the Amstelkerk on the Amstelveld is best known. There has been a bridge here for centuries.

name: Brug 75
en: Brug 75 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located in the Utrechtsestraat and crosses the Prinsengracht. It is the second last bridge over the Prinsengracht before it reaches the Frans Hendri

name: Brug 75
en: Brug 75 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Utrechtsestraat and crosses the Prinsengracht. It is the last bridge of the Utrechtsestraat heading out of the city, the bridge once built over the Achtergracht having been demolished when that canal was filled in.

name: Brug 81
en: Brug 81 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the northern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and spans the Reguliersgracht.

name: Brug 81
en: Brug 81 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the northern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and spans the Reguliersgracht. For several centuries shipping and road traffic at this crossing of waterways were arranged so that no bridge ever lay in the western quay of the Reguliersgracht over the Lijnbaansgracht as we know it now.

name: Brug 811
en: Brug 811 is a building art work in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is located in the Buitenveldertselaan and crosses a drainage ditch that ends in "Kleine Wetering"; it lands in the south on 't Kleine Loopveld. name: Brug 811
en: Brug 811 is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuid. It lies in the Buitenveldertselaan and crosses a drainage channel ending in the Kleine Wetering, landing to the south on 't Kleine Loopveld. It was built to create a through route between Amsterdam and Amstelveen, continuing in a culvert and Brug Uilenstede.

name: Brug 812
en: Brug 812 is a building art work in Amsterdam-Zuid. This bridge was built around 1963 in a footpath between De Cuserstraat and Kalfjeslaan. The path crosses 't Kleine Loopveld and lies over a pond south of De Cuserstraat 3. The bridge was designed by Dirk Sterenberg of the Department of Public Works, who designed more bridges between the

name: Brug 812
en: Brug 812 is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuid. It was built around 1963 in a footpath between the De Cuserstraat and the Kalfjeslaan. The path cuts through 't Kleine Loopveld and crosses a pond south of De Cuserstraat 3. It was designed by Dirk Sterenberg of the Dienst der Publieke Werken, who designed several bridges around the Kalfjeslaan.

name: Brug 87
en: Brug 87 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the western quay of the Prinsengracht and spans the Spiegelgracht. Next to bridge 87 is bridge 69 spanning the Prinsengracht. Both bridges are surrounded by municipal and national monuments. The bridge is already drawn on the 1675 plan by Jacobus de la Feuille. name: Brug 87
en: Brug 87 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the western quay of the Prinsengracht and spans the Spiegelgracht. Bridge 69 lies beside it, over the Prinsengracht. Both are surrounded by municipal and national monuments. The bridge is already drawn on Jacobus de la Feuille's map of 1675.

name: Brug 89
en: Brug 89 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Weteringstraat and spans the Lijnbaansgracht, its far end joining the Weteringpoort (bridge 90). A bridge has been here for centuries: both Daniël Stalpaert in 1662 and Frederik de Wit in 1688 drew one here on their city maps.

name: Brug 89
en: Brug 89 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located in the Weteringstraat. It spans the Lijnbaansgracht. The outlet of the bridge is connected to the Weteringpoort (bridge 90). The bridge is anachronistic. A bridge has been lying here for centuries.

name: Brug 94
en: Brug 94 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It crosses the Leidsegracht and connects the Raamdwarsstraat to the north with the quay of the Lijnbaansgracht to the south. The old building and national monument Leidsegracht 108 stands north of the bridge, and the modern Lijnbaansgracht police station to the south.

name: Brug 94
en: Brug 94 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located over the Leidsegracht and forms the connection between the Raamdwarsstraat (north) and the quay of the Lijnbaansgracht (south).

name: Brug 96
en: Brug 96 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the western quay of the Prinsengracht and crosses the Passeerdersgracht. A bridge has been here for centuries: it is already drawn on Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode's map of 1625 as a bridge over the Prince Graft and Passeerders Graft.

name: Brug 96
en: Brug 96 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the western quay of the Prinsengracht and crosses the Passeerdersgracht. There has been a bridge here for centuries. On the map of Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode from 1625, the bridge is already drawn as a bridge over the Prince Graft and Passeerders Graft.

name: Brug 97
en: Brug 97 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the southeastern quay of the Spiegelgracht, spans the Lijnbaansgracht and leads to the Weteringschans, locally once called Extended Spiegelgracht (but there was no canal) and Zieseniskade. Along the extension of the bridge is the Museum Bridge to the Rijksmuseum. The bridge is surrounded

name: Brug 97
en: Brug 97 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the south-eastern quay of the Spiegelgracht, spans the Lijnbaansgracht and leads to the Weteringschans, once known locally as Verlengde Spiegelgracht and Zieseniskade. The Museumbrug to the Rijksmuseum lies in line with it.

name: Brug 98
en: Brug 98 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and crosses the Passeerdersgracht.

name: Brug 98
en: Brug 98 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the eastern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and crosses the Passeerdersgracht. Since the late 18th century the Lijnbaansgracht has stopped here at the Raamplein, first called Malagplein, and only resumes at the Leidsegracht, with a culvert said to run beneath the site.

name: Buchenwald Memorial
en: The Buchenwaldmonument is a memorial in the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery. The monument, in the form of a gravestone, was unveiled on 26 October 1955, a week after the burial of an urn holding ashes of victims and earth from Buchenwald, Putten, Lidice, Dachau, Warsaw, Auschwitz and Oradour.

name: Buchenwald Memorial
en: The Buchenwald monument is a monument placed on De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery. The monument, in the form of a gravestone, was unveiled on October 26, 1955. name: Buiksloterdraaibrug
en: The Buiksloterdraaibrug (number 2205) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Buiksloterkerk
en: The Buiksloterkerk is the former village church of the dyke village of Buiksloot in Amsterdam-Noord. It does not stand along the Buiksloterdijk but slightly lower on the Buiksloterkerkpad. Rural in setting and surrounded by a graveyard, it dates from 1609 and was listed as a national monument in 1970.

name: Buiksloterkerk
en: The Buiksloterkerk is the (former) village church of the dike village Buiksloot in Amsterdam-Noord. The church building is not along the Buiksloterdijk, but slightly lower on the Buiksloterkerkpad. The church is located nationally and is surrounded by a cemetery. The building was included in the register of national monuments in 1970.

name: Bullebak
en: De Bullebak, bridge 149, is a double bascule bridge in Amsterdam over the Brouwersgracht, connecting the Marnixstraat with the Korte Marnixstraat at the Marnixkade. It is built of wood, steel, brick and concrete. It should not be confused with the Bullebakssluis (bridge 160), further along the Marnixstraat.

name: Bullebak
en: The Bullebak, bridge 149, is a double bascule bridge in Amsterdam over the Brouwersgracht, which connects the Marnixkade, the Marnixstraat with the Korte Marnixstraat at the level of the Marnixkade. The bridge is made of wood, steel, brick and concrete.

name: Bullebaksluis
en: The Bullebakssluis (bridge number 160) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a different bridge from De Bullebak, further along the Marnixstraat.

name: Bullewijkpadbrug
en: The Bullewijkpadbrug (bridge 1083) is a structure from 1981 in Amsterdam-Zuid. Since the Gaasperdammertunnel was built it is the only bridge still standing in the 1080-1089 series. It was designed as a viaduct by Dirk Sterenberg of the Dienst der Publieke Werken.

name: Bullewijkpadbrug
en: The Bullewijkpadbrug (bridge 1083) is a structural work of art from 1981 in Amsterdam-Zuid. It has been the only existing bridge in the series 1080-1089 since the construction of the Gaasperdammertunnel. The design for the bridge in the form of a viaduct came from Dirk Sterenberg working at the Department of Public Works.

name: Camera Obscurabrug
en: The Camera Obscurabrug (bridge 322) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in line with the Leeuwendalersweg to the south and spans the Erasmusgracht, which west of the bridge takes the name Burgemeester Van Tienhovengracht. The bridge dates from 1961/1962.

name: Camera Obscurabrug
en: The Camera Obscurabrug (bridge 322) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is located in the extension of the Leeuwendalersweg southwards. It spans the Erasmusgracht, which west of the bridge is named Burgemeester Van Tienhovengracht.

name: Caroline Herschelbrug
en: Caroline Herschelbrug (bridge 115) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. This pedestrian bridge connects Celebesstraat with the Ooster Ringdijk and spans the ring canal of Watergraafsmeer. A bridge with a budget of 5500 guilders was built there in 1927. The bridge was designed at the time by Piet Kramer of the Department of Public Works.

name: Caroline Herschelbrug
en: Caroline Herschelbrug (bridge 115) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. This footbridge connects the Celebesstraat with the Ooster Ringdijk, spanning the ring canal of the Watergraafsmeer. A bridge was built here in 1927 with a budget of 5,500 guilders, designed by Piet Kramer of the Dienst der Publieke Werken.

name: Cecilia van Alphen-Jagtmanbrug
en: The Cecilia van Alphen-Jagtmanbrug (bridge 912) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. It connects the Buiksloterdijk to the west with a T-junction to the east. Between house numbers 240-242, a municipal monument, and 248, the Buiksloterdijk has a side road running north-east to that junction.

name: Cecilia van Alphen-Jagtmanbrug
en: The Cecilia van Alphen-Jagtmanbrug (bridge 912) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-North. It forms the connection between the western Buiksloterdijk and a T-intersection on the eastern side. name: Ceintuurbrug
en: The Ceintuurbrug (bridge no. 116) is a slab bridge over the Boerenwetering in Amsterdam-Zuid. It connects the Ceintuurbaan with the Roelof Hartstraat and forms part of the ring of streets just outside the inner-city ring. It should not be confused with the Nieuwe Amstelbrug (bridge no. 101) at the other end of the Ceintuurbaan.

name: Ceintuurbrug
en: The Ceintuurbrug (bridge no. 116) is a plate bridge over the Boerenwetering in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge connects the Ceintuurbaan with the Roelof Hartstraat and is part of the ring of streets that lie just outside the inner city ring.

name: Charley Tooropbrug
en: The Charley Tooropbrug (bridge 656) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in the Postjesweg and spans a ditch running parallel to the Ringspoorbaan and metro line 50. The Postjesweg becomes the Robert Fruinlaan here. There is a ditch on the far side of the railway too, but it is not bridged.

name: Charley Tooropbrug
en: The Charley Tooropbrug (bridge 656) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located on Postjesweg and spans a ditch that runs parallel to the Ringspoorbaan and metro line 50 there. Postjesweg transitions into Robert Fruinlaan here. name: Chinatown
en: Chinatown is the Chinese quarter of Amsterdam. It lies around the Geldersekade and the Zeedijk in the old inner city, Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Church of England
en: Christ Church in Amsterdam is a former cloth hall on the Groenburgwal converted into an Anglican church. It is one of the first, possibly the first, buildings in the Netherlands in the neo-Gothic manner. It was entered in the monuments register on 28 April 1970.

name: Cinecenter
en: Cinecenter is an Amsterdam cinema in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located at Lijnbaansgracht 236 near Leidseplein. The cinema or film house was in 1979 the continuation of the CinéTol cinema, which was closed approximately at the same time by Cor Koppies. name: Collectie Six
en: The Collectie Six is the collective name for the heritage of the Six family, which besides the family portraits includes the family archive and works of art and antiques connected with the family. The Six Stichting, the Stichting Stella Duce, the Jan Six Stichting founded in 2010 and Stichting Amstel 218 together make up the collection.

name: Collectie Six
en: The Collectie Six is the common name for the patrimony of the Six family that, in addition to the family portraits, includes the family archive and art and antique objects related to the family, among other things.

name: Commandantsbrug
en: Commandantsbrug is the unofficial name of structure bridge 2361 in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Compagnietheater
en: The Compagnietheater is housed in the former church of the Reformed Lutheran church on the Kloveniersburgwal in Amsterdam.

name: Corry Tendeloobrug
en: The Corry Tendeloobrug (bridge 713) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located on Johan Huizingalaan and spans a canal that runs parallel to Aletta Jacobslaan and Louwesweg on the north side. name: Corry Tendeloobrug
en: The Corry Tendeloobrug (bridge 713) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in the Johan Huizingalaan and spans a canal running parallel to the Aletta Jacobslaan and Louwesweg on the north side. At the crossing with the Johan Huizingalaan the Aletta Jacobslaan becomes the Louwesweg.

name: Dageraadsbrug
en: The Dageraadsbrug (bridge 353) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Dam Square Victims 7 mei 1945
en: A plaque and thirty-two street stones on the Dam in Amsterdam-Centrum commemorate the victims of the Shooting on the Dam on May 7, 1945.

name: Dam Square Victims 7 mei 1945
en: A plaque and thirty-two paving stones on the Dam in Amsterdam-Centrum commemorate the victims of the shooting on the Dam on 7 May 1945.

name: De Ark
en: De Ark is a church building in the Slotervaart district in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The church was built in 1960-'61 according to the design of architect Piet Zanstra. The building has been on the municipal monument list since 2008 and on the Top-100 of young monuments of Amsterdam.

name: De Dokwerker
en: De Dokwerker is a statue and monument on the Jonas Daniël Meijerplein in Amsterdam commemorating the February Strike of 1941. It was designed and made by the sculptor Mari Andriessen on the commission of the Amsterdam city council. The Haarlem carpenter and contractor Willem Termetz, who knew Andriessen before the war, modelled for it in 1951.

name: De Dokwerker
en: De Dokwerker is a statue and monument on Jonas Daniël Meijerplein in Amsterdam in memory of the February Strike of 1941. name: De Dolphijn
en: The house De Dolphijn is a canal house at Singel 140-142 in Amsterdam. Its best-known resident was Frans Banninck Cocq, who lived there when Rembrandt painted Cocq's militia company between 1640 and 1642, in the painting now known as The Night Watch.

name: De Duifbrug
en: De Duifbrug, Duyfjesbrug or Duyfjessluis is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the eastern quay of the Reguliersgracht across the Prinsengracht.

name: De Duifbrug
en: De Duifbrug, also Duyfjesbrug or Duyfjessluis, is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the eastern quay of the Reguliersgracht over the Prinsengracht. On the south side of the Prinsengracht here the whole frontage consists of municipal and national monuments, the best known being the 1857 church De Duif, after which the bridge is named.

name: De Hallen
en: The Hallen is a cultural center in the Kinkerbuurt in Amsterdam-West, with more than two million visitors per year. It houses the Filmhallen, FoodHallen, De Hallen Studios, Kanarie Club, Hal West, various shops, a hotel, a daycare center, the Beeldend Gesproken gallery and a branch of the Openbare Bibliotheek Amsterdam with reading café Belcampo. name: De Hallen
en: De Hallen is a cultural centre in the Kinkerbuurt in Amsterdam-West with more than two million visitors a year. It houses the Filmhallen, FoodHallen, De Hallen Studio's, Kanarie Club, Hal West, various shops, a hotel, a nursery, the gallery Beeldend Gesproken and a branch of the Amsterdam public library.

name: De hongerwinter
en: De hongerwinter is a war memorial on the Eastern Islands in Amsterdam-Centrum, concerning the famine winter of 1944/1945. It exists in two versions. The original, by Hildo Krop, is placed in the Oosterkerk; it was first mounted on the street side but was eaten away over the years by weather and soot.

en: De hongerwinter is a war monument on the Eastern Islands in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is about the hunger winter of 1944/1945. It exists in two versions: The original, by Hildo Krop, is located in the Oosterkerk. name: De Knoop
en: De knoop is an artistic work in Amsterdam-Noord. The name, in use for many years, refers to an originally untitled work by André Volten. The sculpture, several metres high, works out an essentially simple idea: it is a boundary marker and at the same time a link between Amsterdam-Noord and the IJ, two intertwined links standing on two supports.

name: De Krakeling
en: De Krakeling is a theater hall in Amsterdam focused on youth theater. De Krakeling was founded in 1978 by Hans Snoek. It was the first theater building in the Netherlands specially designed for youth theater. The name "De Krakeling" was a reference to the adjacent Koekjesbrug in the Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat. name: De Nieuwe Stad
en: Kerkcentrum De Nieuwe Stad is a church in Amsterdam-Zuidoost (Bijlmermeer), built in 1992/1993 and designed by the architects Lafour and Wijk.

name: De Vriendschap
en: De Vriendschap is a windmill built in 1900 on the site of a mill that burned down in 1899. It stands at Utrechtseweg 11a on the Utrechtse Vecht in Weesp.

name: Dick Schmüllbrug
en: Dick Schmüllbrug (bridge 415) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The traffic bridge, also carrying GVB bus 15, lies in the Parnassusweg and spans the Zuider Amstelkanaal. The Stadionkade runs along it to the north and the Locatellikade and Henri Viottakade to the south. It was designed in the Amsterdam School style.

name: Dick Schmüllbrug
en: Dick Schmüllbrug (bridge 415) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The traffic bridge, over which GVB bus 15 also runs, is located on Parnassusweg and spans the Zuider Amstel Canal. In the north, the Stadionkade runs along the bridge and in the south the Locatellikade and Henri Viottakade.

name: Dirk de Waterduikerbrug
en: The Dirk de Waterduikerbrug (bridge 617) is a fixed bridge in the Slotermeer district in the Amsterdam Nieuw-West district. The bridge is located in the Noordzijde street and crosses a culvert, which connects the water of the marina on the north side of the Sloterplas with a narrow canal that runs in a northerly direction.

name: Dirk de Waterduikerbrug
en: The Dirk de Waterduikerbrug (bridge 617) is a fixed bridge in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in the street Noordzijde and crosses a culvert connecting the water of the marina on the north side of the Sloterplas with a narrow canal running north.

name: Doelensluis
en: The Doelensluis (bridge 220) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Dominicuskerk
en: The Dominicuskerk is a neo-Gothic church building on Spuistraat in Amsterdam. It was built as a Roman Catholic Parish Church of St. Dominic by Pierre Cuypers and served by the Dominicans. The church is no longer part of the Catholic Church, but is used by the Dominican community and rented out.

name: Dorpskerk Durgerdam
en: The Dorpskerk Durgerdam, originally the Reformed church of Durgerdam, is the Protestant church of Durgerdam in Amsterdam-Noord. It does not stand along the Durgerdammerdijk but slightly lower behind it. Its congregation belongs to the Protestant Church in the Netherlands.

name: Dr. Samuel de Ranitzbrug
en: The Dr. Samuel de Ranitzbrug (bridge no. 187), also known as the Spinozabrug, is a former railway bridge over the Singelgracht in Amsterdam, between the Mauritskade and the Spinozastraat. The city of Amsterdam also refers to it as bridge 187. It is part of the waterway between the Open Havenfront and the Amstel.

name: Dr. Samuel de Ranitzbrug
en: The Dr. Samuel de Ranitzbrug (bridge no. 187), also known as the Spinoza Bridge, is a former railway bridge over the Singelgracht in Amsterdam, between the Mauritskade and the Spinozastraat. The Municipality of Amsterdam also refers to the bridge as bridge 187. The bridge is part of the waterway between the Open Havenfront and the Amstel.

name: Drieharingenbrug
en: The Drieharingenbrug (bridge 320) is a double lift bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge forms the connection between the Realeneiland and the Prinseneiland and spans the Realengracht. It lies southwards along the extension of the Vierwindendwarsstraat and leads to the Prinseneiland street. East of the bridge is the Zandhoeksbrug with the same appearance

name: Drieharingenbrug
en: The Drieharingenbrug (bridge 320) is a double drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects Realeneiland with Prinseneiland, spanning the Realengracht. It lies south in line with the Vierwindendwarsstraat and leads to the street Prinseneiland. The identical-looking Zandhoeksbrug lies to its east.

name: Drs. P-brug
en: The Drs. P-brug (bridge 2115) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. Its working name was the Ridderspoorbrug.

name: Duizendste Brug
en: The Duizendste brug (bridge 684) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It spans the Postjeswetering, connecting the Antillenstraat in the Surinamebuurt with the Rembrandtpark. It is the larger sister of bridges 682 and 683, and by that analogy also a daughter of the Torontobrug.

name: Dutch National Opera & Ballet
en: Nationale Opera & Ballet, formerly Het Muziektheater Amsterdam, is a theatre in Amsterdam built specially for staging operas, ballets and other forms of music theatre. It is also the name of the organisation that, besides the theatre, comprises the companies De Nationale Opera and Het Nationale Ballet.

name: Dutch National Opera & Ballet
en: National Opera & Ballet (formerly Het Muziektheater Amsterdam) is a theater in Amsterdam that was specially built for the performance of operas, ballets and other forms of music theater. It is also the name of the organization that includes the companies De Nationale Opera and Het Nationale Ballet in addition to the theater. The theater is part of he

name: Eén Honderd Roedebrug
en: Brug 347 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Elsje Christiaensbrug
en: The Elsje Christiaensbrug (bridge 2474) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-North. The traffic bridge is located over the Buiksloterkanaal and is located on Tolhuisweg.

name: Elsje Christiaensbrug
en: The Elsje Christiaensbrug (bridge 2474) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The traffic bridge crosses the Buiksloterkanaal and lies in the Tolhuisweg, which in the 21st century grew into a traffic route between the Van der Pekbuurt, a relatively old residential area, and the newer Overhoeksbuurt.

name: Elthetokerk
en: The former Elthetokerk was a Reformed church building at the corner of Insulindeweg and Kramatweg in the Indische Buurt in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Etty Hillesumbrug
en: The Etty Hillesumbrug (bridge 409) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Eva Schalkbrug
en: The Eva Schalkbrug (bridge 997) is a fixed bridge for pedestrians and cyclists in Amsterdam-Noord. It lies in the Noorderpark and spans both part of the park and the Noord-Hollandsch Kanaal. The whole area was reshaped in the 2000s and 2010s by the construction of the Noord-Zuidlijn, when the Nieuwe Leeuwarderweg was lowered.

name: Eva Schalkbrug
en: The Eva Schalkbrug (bridge 997) is a permanent bridge for pedestrians and cyclists in Amsterdam-Noord. It is located in Noorderpark and spans both part of the park and the North Holland Canal. In the years zero and ten of the 21st century, as a result of the construction of the North-South Line, the entire surrounding area here was adapted.

name: Ezelsbrug
en: The Ezelsbrug (bridge no. 1904) is a structure in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Faralda NDSM Crane Hotel Amsterdam
en: The Crane Hotel Faralda (Kraanhotel Faralda) is a hotel located on top of a Rijksmonumentale crane on the NDSM site, a former shipyard on the banks of the IJ in Amsterdam-North. name: Faralda NDSM Crane Hotel Amsterdam
en: The Crane Hotel Faralda is a hotel housed at the top of a listed crane on the NDSM site, a former shipyard on the banks of the IJ in Amsterdam-Noord. The former NDSM crane, number 13, was built in the 1950s by the Hensen firm, and was left after the shipbuilder went bankrupt in 1984.

name: Fatih
en: The Fatih mosque is a mosque on the Rozengracht in the Jordaan, Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located in the former Roman Catholic St. Ignatius Church, also known as De Zaaier.

name: Filmhallen
en: The Filmhallen, also known as FilmHallen, is a movie theater in the De Hallen complex in the former tram depot Tollensstraat in Amsterdam-West. The operators are Kadir Selçuk and Alex Rutten of The Movies. The cinema has been open since September 4, 2014, with the premiere of the Dutch feature film Nena by Saskia Diesing on September 8.

name: Filmhuis Cavia
en: Filmhuis Cavia is a film theater in the Van Hallstraat in the Amsterdam Staatsliedenbuurt that is run entirely by volunteers. The cinema emerged in the 1980s from the squatting movement and has a simple formula: it shows what cannot be seen elsewhere. Filmhuis Cavia is located in the former Prinses Beatrix Schipp

name: Fort bij Uitermeer
en: Fort Uitermeer is an old fort that formed part of the New Dutch Waterline and later the Defence Line of Amsterdam. It lies in the North Holland municipality of Weesp on the east bank of the Vecht, south-east of Weesp near the hamlet of Uitermeer, with Fort bij Hinderdam to the south-west and the Weesp fortress to the north-west.

name: Fort bij Uitermeer
en: Fort Uitermeer is an old fort that was included in the New Holland Water Line and later the Stelling of Amsterdam. It is located in the North Holland municipality of Weesp on the eastern bank of the Vecht, southeast of Weesp near the hamlet of Uitermeer. To the southwest is the Fort at Hinderdam and to the northwest is the Weesp Fortress.

name: Frans Hendriksz Oetgensbrug
en: The Frans Hendricksz. Oetgensbrug (bridge 76) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the western quay of the Amstel and spans the Prinsengracht. The bridge is the last bridge of the Prinsengracht before it flows into the same Amstel. The bridge is also on the southeastern border of the Amsterdam canal belt.

name: Frans Hendriksz Oetgensbrug
en: The Frans Hendricksz. Oetgensbrug (bridge 76) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the western quay of the Amstel and spans the Prinsengracht. It is the last bridge of the Prinsengracht before that canal flows into the Amstel, and marks the south-eastern edge of Amsterdam's canal ring. It has been a municipal monument since 1995.

name: Fré Cohenbrug
en: The Fré Cohenbrug is a fixed bridge with diving platform in Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam. The bridge is located in the Zaaiersweg in Betondorp and spans the Molenwetering, which comes from under the Rinus Michelsbrug in the Middenweg. That Molenwetering also forms a ring ditch westward around the Nieuwe Oosterbegraafplaats.

name: Fré Cohenbrug
en: The Fré Cohenbrug is a fixed bridge with a culvert in Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam. It lies in the Zaaiersweg in Betondorp and spans the Molenwetering, which comes from under the Rinus Michelsbrug in the Middenweg. Westward that watercourse also forms a ring ditch around the Nieuwe Oosterbegraafplaats. It is a fixed brick bridge in the Amsterdam School style.

name: Fusillade
en: Fusillade, also known as The Fallen Hornblower, is a bronze statue in the Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, made in 1954 by Gerrit Bolhuis. Here, the German army executed thirty political prisoners on March 12, 1945 as a reprisal for a resistance act.

name: Galgenbrug
en: The Galgenbrug (bridge 315) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located between Bickerseiland and Prinseneiland. It was built between 1625 (the map by Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode from 1625 does not show the bridge) and 1649 (the map by Joan Blaeu does show the bridge).

name: Galgenbrug
en: The Galgenbrug (bridge 315) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies between Bickerseiland and Prinseneiland. It was built between 1625, as Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode's map of that year does not show it, and 1649, as Joan Blaeu's map does. Gerrit de Broen (II)'s map of 1737 shows an oorgat bridge here.

name: Gedenksteen
en: The Gedenksteen voor het voormalig Huis van Bewaring, also called the Gedenksteen 4 mei, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The sculpture was designed by the architect Pieter Zaanen, who was responsible for the new building around 1990 on the Max Euweplein. It stands on a separate part of the square towards the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen.

name: Geert Geertsenbrug
en: The Geert Geertsenbrug (bridge 395) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The pedestrian bridge is located on the western edge of Erasmus Park and provides access from Hondiusstraat and Mercatorstraat. It spans the ring moat surrounding the park. Near the entrance is the restaurant Terrasmus (location 2022) located in the park.

name: Geert Geertsenbrug
en: The Geert Geertsenbrug (bridge 395) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The footbridge lies on the western edge of the Erasmuspark and provides access from the Hondiusstraat and Mercatorstraat, spanning the ring ditch around the park. The bridge dates from around 1970.

name: Gemeenlandshuis
en: The Gemeenlandshuis of Diemen stands at Diemerzeedijk 27 in Amsterdam-Oost. As the name suggests it was originally a water board house. The building stands in the shadow of the Zeeburgerbrug.

name: George Madurobrug
en: The George Madurobrug (bridge 1036) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost, a combination of a bridge and a viaduct. It crosses a foot and cycle path in the Nelson Mandelapark and a drainage channel of that same park. It lies in the Karspeldreef, a through route in Amsterdam-Zuidoost that cuts the park in two.

name: George Madurobrug
en: The George Madurobrug (bridge 1036) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is a combination of a bridge and viaduct. It crosses a foot and bicycle path in Nelson Mandelapark and a drainage ditch from the same park. The structure is located in Karspeldreef, a main route in Amsterdam-Zuidoost, which cuts through the park in half.

name: Ger van Zanenbrug
en: Ger van Zanenbrug (bridge 2372) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, serving as the successor to bridge 700.

name: Gerard Dou Synagogue
en: The Gerard Doustraat Synagogue in the De Pijp district of Amsterdam was built in 1892 for the Ashkenazi congregation Tesjoe'at Israël. The architect E.M. Rood (1851-1929) chose a neo-Renaissance style. Among the houses in the street the synagogue at number 238 is barely noticeable, which may be why the Germans overlooked it.

name: Gerard Dou Synagogue
en: The Synagoge Gerard Doustraat in the Amsterdam district of de Pijp was built in 1892 at the behest of Ashkenazi chevre Tesjoe'at Israel (Hulpe Israëls). Architect E.M. Rood (1851–1929) chose a neo-Renaissance architectural style. Between the residential houses on the street, the synagogue Gerard Doustraat 238 hardly stands out.

name: Gerda Tarobrug
en: The Gerda Tarobrug (bridge 2125) is a constructional work of art under construction in Amsterdam-Oost. From August 2021, work began on the construction of this bridge that is to connect Centrumeiland and Strandeiland in IJburg. The bridge will be located over the Merdekagracht. name: Gerda Tarobrug
en: The Gerda Tarobrug (bridge 2125) is a structure under construction in Amsterdam-Oost. Work began in August 2021 on this bridge, which is to connect Centrumeiland with Strandeiland in IJburg. It will cross the Merdekagracht.

name: Gerrie Mührenbrug
en: The Gerrie Mührenbrug (bridge 2235) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the traffic bridges (the others are for slow traffic) that forms the connection within the Park de Meer neighborhood within the Watergraafsmeer, which rose from the ground here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Gierzwaluwbrug
en: Brug 1189, or Gierzwaluwbrug, is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It lies in a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring of water around an island, in line with bridge 1187. The first bridge here dated from 1970: Dirk Sterenberg of the Dienst der Publieke Werken designed a wooden footbridge almost ten metres long.

name: Goudvinkbrug
en: Bridge 1187 or Goudvinkbrug is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located on a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring lake around an island. The first bridge built here dates back to 1970. Dirk Sterenberg of the Public Works Department designed a nearly ten-meter-long wooden footbridge that did not have bridge pillars.

name: Goudvinkbrug
en: Brug 1187, or Goudvinkbrug, is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It lies in a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring of water around an island. The first bridge here dated from 1970: Dirk Sterenberg of the Dienst der Publieke Werken designed a wooden footbridge almost ten metres long, built without piers.

name: Grenspaal
en: Grenspaal, also known as the Column-bearing Turtle or Monument of Jacob Israël de Haan is a statue in Amsterdam-Centrum. It was made by Hans 't Mannetje. name: Grimnessesluis
en: The Grimnessesluis (bridge 202) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The short traffic bridge provides the connection between the east side of the street section of the Rokin and the Oude Turfmarkt. It spans the small waterway between the Grimburgwal and the same Rokin, but then open water.

name: Grimnessesluis
en: The Grimnessesluis (bridge 202) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The short traffic bridge connects the eastern side of the street section of the Rokin with the Oude Turfmarkt, spanning the small waterway between the Grimburgwal and that same Rokin where it is open water. It is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Groene spechtbrug
en: Brug 1186, or Groene spechtbrug, is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It lies in a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring of water around an island. name: Groentemarktbrug
en: The Groentemarktbrug (bridge 156) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located in Marnixstraat. It spans a passage between on the one hand (on the center side) the Lauriergracht (with bridge 110 over it) and Lijnbaansgracht and on the other hand (west side) the Singelgracht.

name: Groentemarktbrug
en: The Groentemarktbrug (bridge 156) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge lies in the Marnixstraat and spans the passage between the Lauriergracht and Lijnbaansgracht on the centre side and the Singelgracht to the west. Several municipal monuments stand north of the bridge.

name: Groentepraambrug
en: The Groentepraambrug (bridge 129) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The footbridge connects Van Kinsbergenstraat with Cabotstraat and spans the Admiralengracht. The bridge is located between the Molenslootbrug and the Machineslootbrug and was built because the distance between these two traffic bridges, about 700 meters, is quite large for pedestrians.

name: Groentepraambrug
en: The Groentepraambrug (bridge 129) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The footbridge connects the Van Kinsbergenstraat with the Cabotstraat, spanning the Admiralengracht. It lies between the Molenslootbrug and the Machineslootbrug, and was built because the roughly 700 metres between those two traffic bridges is a long way on foot.

name: Groote Museum
en: The Groote Museum is a museum on the Plantage Middenlaan in Amsterdam exploring the connections between people, animals, plants, microbes and the earth. It occupies the first floor of the former main building of Artis and is run by Artis, but can be visited independently of the zoo.

name: Gustav Leonhardtbrug
en: Gustav Leonhardtbrug (bridge 449) is a fixed bridge in the Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is for pedestrians and cyclists only and leads to the Willem Landréstraat entrance in the Componistenbuurt. It dates from 1962, after the Willem Landréstraat was laid out and built up around 1954.

name: Gustav Leonhardtbrug
en: Gustav Leonhardtbrug (bridge 449 is a fixed bridge in Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is only suitable for pedestrians and cyclists, and leads to entrance/exit Willem Landréstraat in the composers' neighborhood.

name: Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug
en: The Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug (bridge 805) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuid. It dates from 1960/1962, when the architect Dirk Sterenberg worked for the Dienst der Publieke Werken. He was allowed to design all the foot and cycle bridges in the Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark and even to lay out the Ontmoetingseiland.

name: Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug
en: The Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug (bridge 805) is a Work of Art in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge dates back to 1960/1962 when architect Dirk Sterenberg worked for the Department of Public Works. He was allowed to design all the foot and bicycle bridges in the Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark and even design the Meeting Island.

name: Haardsteebrug
en: The Haardsteebrug (bridge 1063) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Haarlemmerpoort
en: The Haarlemmerpoort on the Haarlemmerplein in Amsterdam is officially called Willemspoort but is never called that in the city. It is in fact the fifth gate on the side of Haarlem that appears in the history of Amsterdam. The earlier gates were part of the fortifications of Amsterdam. name: Haarlemmerpoort
en: The Haarlemmerpoort on the Haarlemmerplein in Amsterdam is officially called the Willemspoort, but is never called that in the city. It is in fact the fifth gate on the Haarlem side in Amsterdam's history. The earlier gates were part of the city's fortifications, and with each expansion the gate moved a little further out.

name: Haarlemmersluis
en: The Haarlemmersluis is a 17th-century lock in the centre of Amsterdam. It lies at the eastern end of the Brouwersgracht, where the Singel flows into the IJ. The fixed bridge at the lock, bridge number 14, connects the Nieuwendijk and the Haarlemmerstraat. The lock is a popular tourist spot, with large numbers of canal boats passing through.

name: Haarlemmersluis
en: The Haarlemmersluis is a 17th-century lock in the center of Amsterdam. The lock is located at the eastern end of the Brouwersgracht, on the site where the Singel flows into the IJ. The fixed bridge (bridge number 14) near the lock connects the Nieuwendijk and Haarlemmerstraat. The lock is a popular tourist attraction.

name: Halvemaansbrug
en: The Halvemaansbrug (bridge 221) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the two quays of the Amstel, called the Binnen Amstel here, in the inner city. On the north side lie a quay of the Kloveniersburgwal and 's-Gravelandseveer; on the south side the Amstel's quay is simply named after the river.

name: Halvemaansbrug
en: The Halvemaansbrug (bridge 221) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms the connection between the two embankments of the Amstel (here called Binnen Amstel) in the city center of Amsterdam. On the north side there is still another embankment of the Kloveniersburgwal and 's-Gravelandseveer (embankment of the Amstel).

name: Han Lammersbrug
en: The Han Lammersbrug (bridge no. 2202) is a pedestrian and cyclist bridge over the Westerdok in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Westerdokskade with the Westerdokseiland, a former railway yard of NS that was redeveloped in the early 21st century as a residential area.

name: Han Lammersbrug
en: The Han Lammersbrug (bridge no. 2202) is a bridge for pedestrians and cyclists over the Westerdok in Amsterdam. It connects the Westerdokskade with Westerdokseiland, a former NS marshalling yard redeveloped as a residential district in the early 21st century. It is named after Han Lammers (1931-2000), a former Amsterdam alderman.

name: Han van Zomerenbrug
en: The Han van Zomerenbrug (bridge 402) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The wooden bridge that is only accessible to pedestrians (a traffic sign indicates that cyclists should disembark!) has been the connection between Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat and Waalstraat since 2009.

name: Han van Zomerenbrug
en: The Han van Zomerenbrug (bridge 402) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The wooden bridge, open to pedestrians only — a sign tells cyclists to dismount — has connected the Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat with the Waalstraat since 2009. It spans the Amstelkanaal and also links the Jozef Israëlskade with the Amstelkade.

name: Hannie Schaftbrug
en: The Hannie Schaftbrug (bridge no. 601) is a structure in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Hanny Michaelisbrug
en: The Hanny Michaelisbrug (bridge 405) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is one of the four bridges that enclose De Kom in the road network. It crosses the Noorder Amstelkanaal, whose south bank is called the Mozartkade, connecting the Stadionweg with the Hobbemakade. It was built around 1927 to a design by Piet Kramer.

name: Hanny Michaelisbrug
en: The Hanny Michaelisbrug (bridge 405) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is one of the four bridges that enclose the De Kom road network. The bridge crosses the Noorder Amstel Canal, whose south bank is called Mozartkade. It connects Stadionweg with Hobbemakade.

name: Hans Kressebrug
en: Bridge 716 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The pedestrian and bicycle bridge spans the Christoffel Plantijngracht, which runs parallel to the Christoffel Plantijnpad. It is located at the height of the Johan Brakensiekhof and the Theo Mann-Bouwmeesterhof.

name: Hans Kressebrug
en: Brug 716 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The foot and cycle bridge spans the Christoffel Plantijngracht, which runs parallel to the Christoffel Plantijnpad, at the Johan Brakensiekhof and the Theo Mann-Bouwmeesterhof. Dick Slebos of the Publieke Werken designed a number of structures for the Christoffel Plantijnpad.

name: Haringpakkersbrug
en: The Haringpakkersbrug (bridge 58) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is named after the Haring Pakkerye, the herring packers' works once located here. The name also survived in the Haringpakkerstoren, demolished in 1829 and standing north-west of the bridge's present position, and in the Haringpakkerssteeg.

name: Hartmanbrug
en: The Hartmanbrug (bridge no. 190) is a slab bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It lies in the Molukkenstraat and spans the Ringvaart, connecting the Indische Buurt with the Watergraafsmeer. The quay along the Ringvaart is called the Valentijnkade on the north side and the Ooster Ringdijk on the south.

name: Hartmanbrug
en: The Hartmanbrug (bridge no. 190) is a plate bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located in the Molukkenstraat and spans the Ringvaart. The bridge thus connects the Indische Buurt with the Watergraafsmeer. The quay along the Ringvaart is called Valentijnkade on the north side and Ooster Ringdijk on the south side.

name: Heibrug
en: The Heibrug (bridge no. 4) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Singel and connects the Heisteeg, towards the centre, with the Wijde Heisteeg to the west. It became necessary after the city expansion of the late 16th century, when the west bank of the Singel was built up. It is drawn on Pieter Bast's city map.

name: Heibrug
en: The Heibrug (bridge no. 4) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Singel and forms the connection between the Heisteeg (towards the center) and Wijde Heisteeg (towards the west). The bridge became necessary after the city expansion at the end of the 16th century, during which the western bank of the Singel was also built up.

name: Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk
en: The Tichelkerk, or Tichel, is a church on the corner of the Lijnbaansgracht and the Tichelstraat in the Amsterdam Jordaan. It was built in 1912 as the Roman Catholic Sint-Antoniuskerk. In 2005 it became the Russian Orthodox Church of St Nicholas of Myra, and in the same year it was designated a municipal monument.

name: Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk
en: The Tichelkerk or Tichel is a church building at the corner of the Lijnbaansgracht and the Tichelstraat in the Amsterdamse Jordaan. It was built in 1912 as a Roman Catholic Sint-Antoniuskerk. In 2005 it became the Russian Orthodox Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk. In the same year the building was designated as a municipal monument. In response to the Russian

name: Hein Donnerbrug
en: The Hein Donnerbrug (bridge number 1922) is a structural work of art on the border of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge was named after Jan Hein Donner in his capacity as a chess player in 1991. The permanent concrete bridge has spanned the Singelgracht since around 1988.

name: Hein Donnerbrug
en: The Hein Donnerbrug (bridge number 1922) is a structure on the boundary of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam-Zuid. It was named in 1991 after Jan Hein Donner in his capacity as a chess player. The fixed concrete bridge has spanned the Singelgracht since around 1988, connecting the Max Euweplein, named after the chess player Max Euwe, with the Weteringschans.

name: Hendrick Jacobsz Staetsbrug
en: The Hendrick Jacobsz. Staetsbrug (bridge 35) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the west bank of the Amstel and spans the Herengracht, which ends here. The canal does continue on the far side, but under the name Nieuwe Herengracht, beginning at the Walter Süskindbrug.

name: Hendrick Jacobsz Staetsbrug
en: The Hendrick Jacobsz. Staetsbrug (bridge 35) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the western bank of the Amstel and spans the Herengracht, which ends here. On the other side, the canal continues, but under the name Nieuwe Herengracht, starting at the Walter Süskind Bridge. There has been a building here for centuries. On the

name: Hennetjesbrug
en: The Hennetjesbrug (bridge 179) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge is located in Nicolaas Beetsstraat and spans the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. Southeast of the bridge was the former site of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis. Here, in May 1889, a traffic collection bridge was opened from the boiler of Bastiaan de Greef, city architect at the Diens

name: Henrietta Leavittbrug
en: The Henrietta Leavittbrug is a fixed bridge in Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam. Formerly the anonymous bridge number 195, it spans the Ringvaart of the Watergraafsmeer at the dividing line between the Tie-Breakers tennis park and the Flevopark, on the west banks of the Nieuwe Diep. The Valentijnkade lies north of the ring canal.

name: Henrietta Leavittbrug
en: The Henrietta Leavittbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam, Watergraafsmeer. The bridge, formerly known as the anonymous bridge number 195, spans the Ringvaart of the Watergraafsmeer near the halfway point of the Tie-Breakers tennis park and the Flevopark, located on the western banks of the Nieuwe Diep. North of the ringvaart lies the Valentijnkade, t

name: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug
en: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It leads to the entrance of the Beatrixpark from the Prinses Irenestraat and crosses an edge watercourse of that park. It was designed in 1969 by the architect Dirk Sterenberg, working for the Dienst der Publieke Werken.

name: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug
en: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge leads to the entrance and exit of Beatrixpark from/to Prinses Irenestraat. The bridge is located over a stream/draining ditch of the aforementioned park. It was designed in 1969 by architect Dirk Sterenberg working for and for the Public Works Service.

name: Herdenkingsmonument
en: Herdenkingsmonument, also known as Commemoration and remembrance, is an artistic work of art in the Gijsbrecht van Amstelpark, Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid. The image of artist Mischa Rakier (born Delft 1970) was placed in 2014 after an order from the municipality of Amsterdam and the South District.

name: Herdenkingsmonument
en: Herdenkingsmonument, also called Herdenken en herinnering, is an artistic work in the Gijsbrecht van Amstelpark in Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid. The sculpture by the artist Mischa Rakier, born in Delft in 1970, was placed in 2014 on a commission from the city of Amsterdam and the Zuid borough.

name: Herepoort
en: The Herepoort was originally one of the city gates of the city of Groningen. The first Herepoort was probably built in the 11th century, the second in the 13th century, the third in the 15th century and the fourth at the beginning of the 17th century. Since 1885, the 17th-century outer gate has been in the garden of the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam.

name: Herepoort
en: The Herepoort was originally one of the city gates of Groningen. The first Herepoort was probably built in the 11th century, the second in the 13th, the third in the 15th and the fourth in the early 17th century. Since 1885 the 17th-century outer gate has stood in the garden of the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam.

name: Het Nieuwe Verbond
en: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Lourdeskerk, now the Kerk van Het Nieuwe Verbond, is a Roman Catholic church in the garden city of Slotermeer in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It was built in the middle of an almost empty site near the corner of the Burgemeester Röellstraat and the Slotermeerlaan, among a number of temporary Catholic schools.

name: Het Nieuwe Verbond
en: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Lourdes church, today the Church of Het Nieuwe Verbond, is a Roman Catholic church in the garden city Slotermeer in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The church was built in the middle of a nearly vacant area near the corner of Burgemeester Röellstraat and Slotermeerlaan, in the middle of a number of (Catholic) emergency schools.

name: Het Veem Theater
en: Veem House for Performance, called Het Veem Theater until 2014, is a production house, workshop, stage, laboratory and centre of expertise for contemporary mime theatre, based in the Het Veem building in Amsterdam. The building stands on the Van Diemenstraat and the Oude Houthaven along the IJ, west of Centraal Station.

name: Hofkerk
en: The Parish Church of the Holy Martyrs of Gorkum is a Roman Catholic church in Amsterdam-Watergraafsmeer. As the Hofkerk it forms part of the Linnaeushof complex designed by the architect Alexander Kropholler.

name: Hoge Sluis
en: The Hogesluis (bridge no. 246) is an Amsterdam monumental double bascule bridge with ten passages, designed by Willem Springer in Parisian style. The older bridge from the 17th century was replaced by the current one in 1883.

name: Hoge Sluis
en: The Hogesluis (bridge no. 246) is a monumental Amsterdam double bascule bridge with ten openings, designed by Willem Springer in a Parisian style. The older 17th-century bridge was replaced by the present one in 1883. The slab bridge, partly a bascule bridge, is decorated with cast-iron ornaments bearing city arms, a stone vase balustrade and obelisks.

name: Horst Blankenburgbrug
en: The Horst Blankenburgbrug (bridge 2293) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam. The bridge is one of the few traffic bridges (most are only for slow traffic) that forms the connection between Watergraafsmeer and the Park de Meer neighborhood, which was built here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Horst Blankenburgbrug
en: The Horst Blankenburgbrug (bridge 2293) is a structure in Amsterdam. It is one of the few traffic bridges — most are for slow traffic only — connecting the Watergraafsmeer with the Park de Meer neighbourhood, which was built here between 1998 and 2002. That neighbourhood is entirely surrounded by a ring ditch.

name: Hortusbrug
en: The Hortusbrug (bridge no. 239) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Nieuwe Herengracht, connecting the Muiderstraat with the Plantage Middenlaan. The concrete bridge from 1960 was designed by Dirk Sterenberg and has two openings, a fixed span and the bascule, with rounded piers between them faced in basalt blocks.

name: Hortusbrug
en: The Hortusbrug (bridge no. 239) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Nieuwe Herengracht and thus connects the Muiderstraat with the Plantage Middenlaan.

name: Houten Huis
en: Het Houten Huys is a building dating from 1528 or shortly thereafter on the Begijnhof in Amsterdam. It is one of the oldest houses in Amsterdam and, along with a building at the beginning of the Zeedijk, one of the two remaining houses with a wooden facade in Amsterdam.

name: Houten Huis
en: Het Houten Huys is a building on the Begijnhof in Amsterdam dating from 1528 or shortly after. It is one of the oldest houses in Amsterdam and, along with a building at the start of the Zeedijk, one of the two surviving houses with a wooden front. From the city's founding almost all Amsterdam houses were built of wood.

name: Hugo de Vriesbrug
en: The Hugo de Vriesbrug (bridge 457) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. Although numbered as a bridge, it is a viaduct or a tunnel depending on the point of view. It spans the Hugo de Vrieslaan and lies in the Gooiseweg. The wish for a road between Amsterdam and Het Gooi dates back to the 1930s.

name: Hugo de Vriesbrug
en: The Hugo de Vriesbrug (bridge 457) is a work of art in Amsterdam-Oost. Although numbered as a bridge, it is a viaduct or tunnel depending on the point of view. The structure spans the Hugo de Vrieslaan and is located in the Gooiseweg.

name: Huis Bartolotti
en: Het Huis Bartolotti (also Het Bonte Huis) is a canal house at Herengracht 170-172 in Amsterdam. It was built around 1617 for Willem van den Heuvel tot Beichlingen, one of the richest Amsterdamers of that time, who had inherited a lot of money from a childless married uncle, Giovanni Battista Bartolotti, a merchant from Bologna. In the will of this uncle

name: Huis Bartolotti
en: Huis Bartolotti, also called Het Bonte Huis, is a canal house at Herengracht 170-172 in Amsterdam. It was built around 1617 for Willem van den Heuvel tot Beichlingen, one of the richest Amsterdammers of his day, who had inherited a great deal of money from a childless uncle by marriage, the Bologna merchant Giovanni Battista Bartolotti.

name: Huis van de wijk Lydia
en: Huize Lydia or Buurthuis Lydia is a multifunctional center located at the corner of Roelof Hartplein, Joh. M. Coenenstraat and Bronckhorststraat in Amsterdam. name: Huiszittenbrug
en: Bridge 8 is the official designation of a bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge had the unofficial name Huiszittenbrug until July 5, 2016, which referred to the Huiszitten warehouse. However, this name has become obsolete. The fixed plate bridge is located in the Raadhuisstraat and spans the Singel.

name: Huiszittenbrug
en: Brug 8 is the official name of a bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Until 5 July 2016 it carried the unofficial name Huiszittenbrug, referring to the Huiszittenpakhuis, but that name has since lapsed. The fixed slab bridge lies in the Raadhuisstraat and spans the Singel. A bridge had stood here for at least two centuries.

name: Huntumbrug
en: The Huntumbrug (bridge 1041) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The viaduct was built in the Karspeldreef, an important traffic route for fast traffic that runs from east to west through the district. It spans the Bijlmerpleinpad, a foot and bicycle path that winds from north to south through the district.

name: Huntumbrug
en: The Huntumbrug (bridge 1041) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The viaduct was built in the Karspeldreef, a major route for fast traffic running east to west through the borough. It spans the Bijlmerpleinpad, a foot and cycle path winding north to south through the borough.

name: HvA
en: The University of Applied Sciences for Economic Studies (HES) in Amsterdam was an HBO educational institution with programs in the field of economics and was a school with a tradition of more than 125 years. Today, it has become part of the economic education institute of the University of Amsterdam.

name: IJ-toren
en: IJ-toren may refer to the IJ-toren on the Veemkade, a 1998 residential tower in Amsterdam, or the IJ-toren on the Piet Heinkade, an office tower from 2002 in Amsterdam.

name: Ikeda Friendship and Peace Center
en: The Sint-Lucaskerk is the former church building of the Roman Catholic Sint-Lucas parish in Amsterdam-Osdorp. When the garden city Osdorp was built from 1958, a Roman Catholic church was also provided for. Pastor H.J. Heesterbeek was appointed building pastor on April 7, 1959 and on August 29 of the same year a temporary church was blessed at the Mee

name: Ikeda Friendship and Peace Center
en: The Sint-Lucaskerk is the former church of the Roman Catholic St Luke's parish in Amsterdam-Osdorp. When the garden city of Osdorp went up from 1958, a Roman Catholic church was provided for as well. H.J. Heesterbeek was appointed building priest on 7 April 1959, and a temporary church was consecrated that August.

name: Ina Boekbinderbrug
en: Ina Boekbinderbrug (bridge 416) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It lies in the Minervalaan and spans the Zuider Amstelkanaal. Hendrik Petrus Berlage already drew this bridge on his plan for Plan Zuid of 1915; even then it was rather narrow compared with the width of the Minervalaan.

name: Ina Boekbinderbrug
en: Ina Boekbinderbrug (bridge 416) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is located in the Minervalaan and spans the Zuider Amstel Canal. Hendrik Petrus Berlage already drew this bridge on his plan for Plan Zuid from 1915. The width of the bridge was already quite narrow compared to the width of the Minervalaan.

name: Ina Boudier Bakkerbrug
en: The Ina Boudier-Bakkerbrug (bridge 609) is a permanent bridge in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam. The bridge is located in Burgemeester Fockstraat and spans the Burgemeester van Tienhovengracht. The bridge was built to open up Slotermeer-Noord. The bridge has its landheads in Gerbrandypark and the southern quay of the aforementioned canal.

name: Ina Boudier Bakkerbrug
en: The Ina Boudier-Bakkerbrug (bridge 609) is a fixed bridge in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam. It lies in the Burgemeester Fockstraat and spans the Burgemeester van Tienhovengracht. It was built to open up Slotermeer-Noord, with its abutments in the Gerbrandypark and the south quay of that canal, and dates from 1953/1954.

name: Isa van Eeghenbrug
en: The Isa van Eeghenbrug is a fixed slab bridge with three openings in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Isaac Israëlsbrug
en: The Isaac Israëlsbrug (bridge 408), also known as the Schildersbrug, is a bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It spans the Noorder Amstelkanaal, connecting the Cornelis Schuytstraat with the Breitnerstraat. The present bridge was built in 1961 and was, at least on the drawing board, the third here, the first having been called the Academiebrug.

name: Isaac Israëlsbrug
en: The Isaac Israëlsbrug, (Bridge 408), also known as Schildersbrug, is a bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge spans the Noorder Amstel Canal and forms the connection between the Cornelis Schuytstraat and the Breitnerstraat.

name: Jacoba van Tongerenbrug
en: The Jacoba van Tongerenbrug (bridge number 602) is a fixed bridge in Slotermeer, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The traffic bridge lies in the Burgemeester Fockstraat and crosses the Afwateringstocht, leading to the Gerbrandypark to the south. It was built in 1953 to a 1950 design by Piet Kramer, though the year stones read 1951.

name: Jacoba van Tongerenbrug
en: The Jacoba van Tongerenbrug (bridge number 602) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, Slotermeer. The traffic bridge is located in Burgemeester Fockstraat and spans the Afwateringstocht. It leads to the southern Gerbrandypark. The bridge was built in 1953 according to a design by Piet Kramer from 1950 (the date stones mention 1951). The bridge is

name: Jan Evertsenbrug
en: The Jan Evertsenbrug (145p) is a work of art in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Although the name is associated with a bridge, it is a system of viaducts and bridges, Amsterdam usually refers to viaducts as bridges. The viaduct and bridge system, entirely made of concrete, is located in the Ringweg Amsterdam and spans the Jan Evertsen and a parallel waterway.

name: Jan Evertsenbrug
en: The Jan Evertsenbrug (145p) is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Although it bears the name of a bridge it is a system of viaducts and bridges; Amsterdam usually calls viaducts bridges. The all-concrete system lies in the Ringweg Amsterdam and spans the Jan Evertsenstraat and a waterway running parallel to it.

name: Jan Schaeferbrug
en: The Jan Schaeferbrug (bridge number 2000) crosses the IJhaven and connects the Piet Heinkade with Java-eiland in Amsterdam's Eastern Docklands. It was designed by the architect Ton Venhoeven and is named after the politician Jan Schaefer (1940-1994). Bus line 43 runs over the bridge.

name: Jan Swammerdambrug
en: The Jan Swammerdambrug (bridge 2291) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge connects the Bilderdijkkade (the western bank of the Bilderdijkgracht) with the Tweede Constantijn Huygensstraat. It spans the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. Southwest of the bridge is the national monument WG-plein 500, the former main building of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis. v

name: Jan Swammerdambrug
en: The Jan Swammerdambrug (bridge 2291) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. It connects the Bilderdijkkade, the west bank of the Bilderdijkgracht, with the Tweede Constantijn Huygensstraat, spanning the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. The national monument WG-plein 500, the former main building of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis, stands to its south-west.

name: Jan van Galenbrug
en: Bridge 382 is a bascule bridge located in Amsterdam-West. The traffic bridge (over which bus lines 18 and 80 also run) is located in Jan van Galenstraat and spans the Western Market Canal. The bridge is located just near the Centrale Markt (now called Foodcenter) which was opened in 1934.

name: Jan van Galenstraat
en: Brug 382 is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. The traffic bridge, which also carries bus lines 18 and 80, lies in the Jan van Galenstraat and spans the Westelijk Marktkanaal. It stands close to the Centrale Markt, opened in 1934 and now called the Foodcenter, and was accordingly used by heavy freight traffic.

name: Jan van Galenstraat
en: Bridge 382 is a bascule bridge located in Amsterdam-West. The traffic bridge (over which bus lines 18 and 80 also run) is located in Jan van Galenstraat and spans the Western Market Canal. The bridge is located just near the Centrale Markt (now called Foodcenter) which was opened in 1934.

name: Jeruzalemkerk
en: The Jeruzalemkerk is a Protestant church on the Jan Maijenstraat in the West borough of Amsterdam, in the De Baarsjes district near the Mercatorplein.

name: Jewish WW2 resistance memorial
en: The Monument Joods Verzet 1940-1945 is a monument in Amsterdam that has stood since 1988 on the corner of the Amstel and the Zwanenburgwal, beside the Stopera. It was raised in memory of all the Jewish resistance members who died in the Second World War, and is the work of the stonemason Joseph Glatt.

name: Jewish WW2 resistance memorial
en: The Monument to Jewish Resistance 1940-1945 is a monument in Amsterdam that has stood on the corner of the Amstel and the Zwanenburgwal, on the side of the Stopera since 1988.
