name: Theater Amsterdam
en: Theater Amsterdam is a theatre in Amsterdam. For the moment it is the only theatre in the city intended for productions that run for as long as the public is interested. It opened on 8 May 2014 with the production Anne, based on the diary of Anne Frank.

name: Theater Amsterdam
en: Theater Amsterdam is a theater in Amsterdam. It is for the time being the only theater in Amsterdam that is intended for performances that run as long as the public is interested. On May 8, 2014, the theater opened with the performance Anne, based on the diary of Anne Frank. Theater Amsterdam is the first theater specially built for theater system

name: Theo Fransmanbrug
en: The Theo Fransmanbrug (bridge number 1788) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. For almost a century the Papaverweg in the Buiksloterham neighbourhood was a dead end running from the built-up area to Zijkanaal I. There was also a small inlet called the Papaverkanaal, for years the site of a city refuse depot.

name: Theo Fransmanbrug
en: The Theo Fransmanbrug (bridge number 1788) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-North. The Papaverweg in the Buiksloterham area was a dead-end road from buildings to Zijkanaal I for almost a century. There was also a docking harbor called Papaverkanaal where for years there was a drainage depot from the City Cleaning Department.

name: Theo Thijssen Museum
en: The Theo Thijssen Museum is a museum in Amsterdam devoted to the writer, teacher and politician Theo Thijssen. It is run by the Stichting Theo Thijssen and occupies the ground floor of Thijssen's birthplace at Eerste Leliedwarsstraat 16.

name: This is Holland
en: THIS IS HOLLAND is a tourist attraction with a panoramic flight simulator in Amsterdam. It opened in 2017 in Amsterdam-Noord, next to the Eye Filmmuseum, in a 24-metre-high cylindrical pavilion on the former Shell site Overhoeks, above the underground car park of the A'DAM Toren.

name: Thomaskerk
en: The Thomaskerk, or De Thomas, on the Prinses Irenestraat in Amsterdam-Zuid was built in 1966 and belongs to the Protestant Church of Amsterdam.

name: Thorbecke statue
en: The statue of Johan Rudolph Thorbecke, or Thorbecke monument, is a 19th-century memorial in Amsterdam to the liberal politician Thorbecke.

name: Tijnmuidenbrug
en: The Tijnmuidenbrug, designated KW517, is a structural work of art in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The structure is located on the Westrandweg, part of the A5 motorway. It spans the Amsterdam traffic road Dortmuiden. The architectural firm Zwarts & Jansma Architecten was responsible for the design of this national road and all its works of art. The road was m

name: Tijnmuidenbrug
en: The Tijnmuidenbrug, designated KW517, is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in the Westrandweg, part of the A5 motorway, and spans the Amsterdam road Dortmuiden. Zwarts & Jansma Architecten were responsible for the design of this motorway and all its structures.

name: Timo Smeehuijzenbrug
en: Timo Smeehuijzenbrug (bridge 407) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Tobacco Theater
en: The Tobacco Theater is a national monument on the theatre street Nes in Amsterdam, at odd numbers 75 to 87. Like other buildings on the Nes, such as the Comedy Theater, Theater De Engelenbak and Frascati, it was originally a tobacco factory. Its angled window bays let a great deal of light into the building.

name: Tobacco Theater
en: The Tobacco Theater is a national monument, located on the "theaterstraat" Nes in Amsterdam (odd house numbers 75 to 87). The building was originally, as well as other buildings in the Nes such as the Comedy Theater, Theater De Engelenbak and Frascati, a tobacco factory.

name: Torenfort aan de Ossenmarkt
en: The Torenfort aan de Ossenmarkt is a tower fort in Weesp in the province of North Holland.

name: Torensluis
en: The Torensluis (bridge no. 9) is a characteristic arched bridge over the Singel in Amsterdam's inner city and, at 42 metres, one of the widest in the city. It is so wide because a tower once stood on it, the Jan Roodenpoortstoren. While it was being designed in 1648 there was a plan to build shops on the very broad bridge.

name: Torensluis
en: The Torensluis (bridge no. 9) is a characteristic arched bridge over the Singel in the Old Town of Amsterdam and with 42 meters one of the widest in the city. The reason for this is that a tower stood on the bridge, the Jan Roodenpoortstoren. During the design of the bridge in 1648, the plan arose to build shops on the very wide bridge, just like

name: Torontobrug
en: The Torontobrug (bridge 350) in Amsterdam is a double bascule bridge on the boundary between De Pijp in Amsterdam-Zuid and Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Amstel. On the west side it lies in line with the Stadhouderskade and at right angles to the Amsteldijk, formerly Utrechtsezijde; on the east side it continues as the Mauritskade.

name: Torontobrug
en: The Torontobrug (bridge 350) in Amsterdam is a double bascule bridge on the border between Amsterdam-Zuid, De Pijp and Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Amstel. On the west side it lies along the Stadhouderskade and is perpendicular to the Amsteldijk (formerly Utrechtsezijde). On the east side it lies along the Mauritskade. From the bridge has

name: Tranen
en: Tranen for the Resistance or Two Tears is an artistic work by Bernard Heesen in one of the passages of the Max Euweplein in the center of Amsterdam. The artwork commemorates the former Detention Center on the Weteringschans. This building was used during the occupation in World War II by the Sicherheitsdienst and Gestapo. A ve

name: Tranen
en: Tranen voor het verzet, or Twee tranen, is an artistic work by Bernard Heesen in one of the passages of the Max Euweplein in the centre of Amsterdam. It commemorates the former house of detention on the Weteringschans, a building used during the occupation in the Second World War by the Sicherheitsdienst and the Gestapo.

name: Trapjesbrug
en: Bridge 130 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The pedestrian bridge, colloquially known as the Trapjesbrug, forms the connection between Tuinstraat and Nieuwe Tuinstraat. It spans the Lijnbaansgracht and lands on the Westerkade (western quay of the Lijnbaansgracht).

name: Trapjesbrug
en: Brug 130 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The footbridge, popularly called the Trapjesbrug, connects the Tuinstraat with the Nieuwe Tuinstraat. It spans the Lijnbaansgracht and lands on the Westerkade, that canal's western quay. A bridge of steel and wood was placed here in 1921 and renovated and raised in 1965.

name: Tulpbrug
en: The Tulpbrug (bridge 255) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam, on the border of the districts Centrum and Oost. The bridge forms the connection between Professor Tulpplein with the Amstel Hotel and the Huddekade on the one hand and the Weesperzijde on the other. It spans the Singelgracht.

name: Tulpbrug
en: The Tulpbrug (bridge 255) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam, on the boundary of the Centrum and Oost boroughs. It links the Professor Tulpplein, with the Amstel Hotel and the Huddekade, to the Weesperzijde, spanning the Singelgracht. Its southern abutment meets the embankment of viaduct 325 and the Torontobrug.

name: Uilenburger Synagoge
en: The Uilenburger Synagoge or Uilenburgersjoel is a synagogue on the Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat on the island of Uilenburg in the former Amsterdam Jewish Quarter. The synagogue was built in Louis XV style in 1766 for the Ashkenazi Jews. The progressive Jewish community Beit Ha'Chidush has been meeting there several times a month since 1997.

name: Utrechtsebrug
en: The Utrechtsebrug (bridge number 439, signed as Utrechtse Brug) is an Amsterdam bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Van Buurenmonument
en: The Van Buurenmonument is a memorial in Amsterdam commemorating Lucas van Buuren.

name: Van Eesteren Museum
en: The Van Eesteren Museum is a museum in Amsterdam Nieuw-West devoted entirely to the architect and town planner Cornelis van Eesteren. Since 22 October 2017 it has been housed in the Van Eesteren Paviljoen at Noordzijde 31.

name: Van Gendt Hallen
en: The Hallen van Stork, Van Gendthallen or Werkspoorhallen are five interconnected halls of the former Werkspoor-Stork factory in Oostenburg in Amsterdam. The buildings are located in the southwest corner of the former factory site, bordered by the Wittenburgervaart, the Oostenburgerdwarsvaart, the Oostenburgervaart and the railway lines between Centraal Stat

name: Van Hallbrug
en: Brug 171 is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. It connects the Van Hallstraat with the Kostverlorenstraat, spanning the Kostverlorenvaart. That waterway is part of the Staandemastroute, so a fixed bridge is not possible here. Originally there was no intention to build a bridge at this spot.

name: Van Hallbrug
en: Bridge 171 is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. It forms the connection between Van Hallstraat and Kostverlorenstraat and spans the Kostverlorenvaart. The Kostverlorenvaart is part of the Staandemast route, hence a fixed bridge is not possible here. Initially, it was not intended to build a bridge here, although

name: Van Mierlobrug
en: Van Mierlobrug (bridge 18) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal with the Herenstraat, spanning the Herengracht. It forms a whole with bridge 19, in the eastern quay of the Herengracht over the Blauwburgwal. It is surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Van Mierlobrug
en: Van Mierlobrug (bridge 18) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal with Herenstraat. It spans Herengracht in the process. The bridge forms a whole with bridge 19 on the eastern quay of Herengracht and over the Blauwburgwal.

name: Varkenssluis
en: The Varkenssluis (bridge no. 204) is a bridge over the Oudezijds Voorburgwal in the Wallengebied area of Amsterdam. The bridge connects Damstraat with Oude Doelenstraat. A bridge has been lying here for centuries. It can already be seen on city maps by Pieter Bast (1599) and Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode (1625).

name: Varkenssluis
en: The Varkenssluis (bridge no. 204) is a bridge over the Oudezijds Voorburgwal in Amsterdam's Wallen district, connecting the Damstraat with the Oude Doelenstraat. A bridge has been here for centuries, appearing on the city maps of Pieter Bast (1599) and Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode (1625). It is named after the pig market held here around the 16th century.

name: Veebrug
en: The Veebrug (bridge 261) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Lozingskanaal and lies in the Veelaan, connecting the Zeeburgerpad with the Zeeburgerdijk. The Veelaan begins at the Cruquiusweg, crosses the Nieuwe Vaart by the Slachthuisbrug, and meets the Molukkenstraat across the Lozingskanaal.

name: Veebrug
en: The Veebrug (bridge 261) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Discharge Canal and is located in the Veelaan. It provides the connection between the Zeeburgerpad and the Zeeburgerdijk. The Veelaan begins at the Cruquiusweg, crosses the Nieuwe Vaart via the Slaughterhouse Bridge and connects to the Molukkenstraat across the Discharge Canal.

name: Veenderijbrug
en: The Veenderijbrug (bridge number 639) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located in the Osdorperweg and spans the Osdorpervaart to the Osdorper Binnenpolder. There has been a bridge here since the 1920s, when the draining of the polder began. Initially this was a loading bridge, it was replaced in the 1940s by a boat

name: Veenderijbrug
en: The Veenderijbrug (bridge number 639) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in the Osdorperweg and spans the Osdorpervaart towards the Osdorper Binnenpolder. A bridge has been here since the 1920s, when peat extraction in the polder began; the original drawbridge was replaced by a fixed bridge in the 1940s.

name: Veeneikbrug
en: The Veeneikbrug is a cycle and foot bridge connecting the Bijlmerweide in Amsterdam-Zuidoost to the west with the Diemerbos in Diemen to the east. It crosses the provincial road N236 on the Amsterdam side, the Gaasp and Weespertrekvaart, and the Stammerdijk on the Diemen side.

name: Veeneikbrug
en: The Veeneikbrug is a bicycle and pedestrian bridge that connects pedestrians and cyclists between the Bijlmerweide in Amsterdam-Zuidoost (west) and the Diemerbos in Diemen (east). The bridge crosses the Provincial road N236 (Amsterdam side), the Gaasp/Weespertrekvaart and the Stammerdijk (Diemer side). On the Amsterdam side it connects to the Gulde

name: Vier Heemskinderenbrug
en: The Vier Heemskinderenbrug, also known as Vier Heemskinderensluis, is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the western quay of the Herengracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. It has been a municipal monument since 1995 and is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Vier Heemskinderenbrug
en: The Vier Heemskinderenbrug, also called the Vier Heemskinderensluis, is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the western quay of the Herengracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. A municipal monument since 1995, it is surrounded by national monuments, one of which, Herengracht 394, has a wall stone under its middle first-floor window.

name: Vierwindstrekenbrug
en: The Vierwindstrekenbrug (bridge no. 381) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West.

name: Vincentiuskerk
en: The Sint-Vincentiuskerk, named after patron saint Vincentius a Paulo, was a Catholic church building in Amsterdam Oud-West. The starting signal was given in July 1899 when the congregation purchased a 50 by 40 meter plot of land for a church and school.

name: Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond
en: De Brakke Grond, full name Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond, is a Flemish cultural center at Nes 45 in Amsterdam. The current building is a design by architect Arthur Staal. De Brakke Grond, located on a square in the middle of the theater district on the Nes, offers performances in the field of performing arts, visual arts, music and other forms of art

name: Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond
en: De Brakke Grond, in full Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond, is a Flemish cultural centre at Nes 45 in Amsterdam. The present building was designed by the architect Arthur Staal. Standing on a small square in the middle of the theatre district on the Nes, it presents performing arts, visual arts, music and other art forms.

name: Volewijckbrug
en: The Volewijckbrug (bridge 2475) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Vondelbrug
en: The Vondelbrug (bridge 200) is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Zuid, connecting Amsterdam Oud-Zuid with Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Vondelmonument
en: The Vondel monument, also known as the Vondelbeeld, is a large statue of the 17th-century Dutch poet and playwright Joost van den Vondel in the Vondelpark in Amsterdam. It was unveiled on 18 October 1867, after which the park itself came to be called the Vondelpark, which became its official name in 1880.

name: Vondelpark Open Air Theater
en: The Vondelpark Open Air Theatre in Amsterdam has staged concerts and performances every summer since 1974, by amateurs and professionals in cabaret, dance, children's theatre and music, in the heart of the Vondelpark. Admission is free, though a voluntary donation is requested.

name: Vondelpark Open Air Theater
en: The Vondelpark Open-Air Theater in Amsterdam has been organizing concerts and performances by amateurs and professional performers in the field of cabaret, dance, children's shows and music in the heart of Vondelpark every summer since 1974. The performances are free to attend, but a voluntary donation is requested. Every weekend in the months of June, July

name: Vredeskerk
en: The Parish Church of Our Lady Queen of Peace or Vredeskerk is a Roman Catholic church between Pijnackerstraat and Van Hilligaertstraat in the southwest corner of the Pijp in Amsterdam-Zuid. The church has been the namesake of Vredeskerkplein since 2004.

name: Vrijburg
en: Diepenbrockstraat 46 is a church building on Diepenbrockstraat in Amsterdam-Zuid. The side facade is on Herman Gorterstraat. Here, between 1931 and 1933, a church building was erected for the Remonstrant Reformed Church in Amsterdam.

name: Vrijheidscarillon
en: The Vrijheidscarillon in Amsterdam is a clockwork toy that was manufactured in 1952 by the company A.H. van Bergen in Heiligerlee at the initiative of the Dutch Committee for National Commemoration. It hung in several places, including on the Dam in 1955. It was offered to the municipality of Amsterdam in 1960. This decided in late May of that year to c

name: Vrijheidscarillon
en: The Vrijheidscarillon in Amsterdam is a carillon made in 1952 by the firm A.H. van Bergen of Heiligerlee at the initiative of the Dutch national commemoration committee. It has hung in several places, including on the Dam in 1955, and was presented to the city of Amsterdam in 1960.

name: Waalseilandbrug
en: Bridge 283 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge over the Waalseilandsgracht forms the connection between the Lastage or Nieuwmarktbuurt and the Waalseiland. On the northeast side are the Buiten Bantammerstraat and the Binnenkant quay.

name: Waalseilandbrug
en: Brug 283 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge over the Waalseilandsgracht connects the Lastage, or Nieuwmarkt quarter, with the Waalseiland. The Buiten Bantammerstraat and the Binnenkant quay lie to the north-east, and the Binnen Bantammerstraat and the Lastageweg to the south-west.

name: Wagon Litsbrug
en: Bridge 387 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Open Havenfront on the west side. It allows pedestrians and cyclists to cross from the west side of Stationsplein and the eastern quay of the Westertoegang to the Prins Hendrikkade at once. On the south side she lands on the foot and bicycle path of the Prins He

name: Wagon Litsbrug
en: Brug 387 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the western side of the Open Havenfront, letting pedestrians and cyclists cross in one go from the west side of the Stationsplein and the eastern quay of the Westertoegang to the Prins Hendrikkade, landing on the south side on that street's foot and cycle path.

name: Walenweeshuissluis
en: The Walenweessluis (bridge 70) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum; sluis here means a stone bridge. It connects the Vijzelstraat with the filled-in Vijzelgracht, crossing the Prinsengracht. The name refers to the Walenweeshuis, the orphanage for children of the French or Walloon church.

name: Walenweeshuissluis
en: The Walenweessluis (bridge 70) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sluis stands for stone bridge here. The bridge forms the connection between Vijzelstraat and the canalized Vijzelgracht. It is located over the Prinsengracht. The name Walenweessluis is a name derived from the Walenweeshuis, the orphanage for children from the French or Walloon church.

name: Warmoesbrug
en: Warmoesbrug may refer to the Warmoesbrug in Amsterdam, bridge 22 and a national monument, or the Warmoesbrug in Delft.

name: Wasknijper
en: De Wasknijper (bridge 177) is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The traffic bridge lies in the Distelweg and crosses the Buiksloterkanaal. It is the northernmost bridge over that canal.

name: waterdraagster
en: Waterdraagster met vissen is an artistic work in Amsterdam-West. A classical fountain originally stood in the garden of the Bellamyplein from 1905. The garden fell into disorder and the city cleared it; the fountain made way for a paddling pool designed by Ko Mulder, where neighbourhood children could splash from late summer 1954.

name: Weesperbrug
en: The Weesperbrug is a fixed steel arch bridge over the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal and forms part of the provincial road N236.

name: West Indian Warehouse
en: The West Indian Warehouse in Amsterdam dates back to 1642 and is located on the western part of Rapenburg, where the Oudeschans flows into the Oosterdok. It was originally owned by the West Indian Company (WIC). The letters GWC on the facade stand for the official name, 'Geoctroyeerde West-Indische Compagnie'. Currently it has the monument status.

name: Westerdoksdijkspoorbrug
en: The Spoorbrug Westerdokseiland (bridge no. 19S) is a former railway bridge in Amsterdam. It connected the tracks of Centraal Station with the goods yard then on Westerdokseiland.

name: Westerdoksluis
en: The Westerdoksluis is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It crosses the connection between the Westerdok and the IJ, carrying the Stadsroute 100 between the Westerdokskade and De Ruijterkade on the south side and the Westerdoksdijk on Westerdokseiland to the north.

name: Westerkeersluis
en: The Westerkeersluis (bridge 346) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge spans the Westerkanaal and is part of the Centrumring S100. It connects Van Diemenstraat with Tasmanstraat. North of the bridge, the wooden sluice doors of the Westerkanaal water dam (sluice 205) between the city and the IJ are visible. The northern doors of that sluice l

name: Westerkeersluis
en: The Westerkeersluis (bridge 346) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. It spans the Westerkanaal and forms part of the S100 centre ring, connecting the Van Diemenstraat with the Tasmanstraat. North of the bridge stand the wooden gates of the Westerkanaal flood barrier (lock 205) between the city and the IJ.

name: Westertoren
en: The Westertoren in Amsterdam is the tower of the Westerkerk, at Prinsengracht 279 by the Westermarkt in Amsterdam-Centrum. The tower is owned by the city of Amsterdam. It was restored from February 2023 until early 2025.

name: Westerwijk
en: Westerwijk or Wester-wijk is a building in Amsterdam with houses, office space and two rooms. The building was built after a tender in June 1925 in 1925/1926 on the Admiraal de Ruyterweg to the design of F.B. Jantzen in the style of the Amsterdam School. The construction cost amounted to just under 80,000 guilders at the time.

name: Weteringpoort
en: The Weteringpoort was one of the eight Amsterdam city gates built during the third and fourth expansions. Part of the city's fortifications, it was, with the Raampoort and the Zaagmolenpoort, one of the smaller gates. Besides a passage with a wooden bridge it also had a waterway opening connecting the Lijnbaansgracht.

name: Weteringpoort
en: The Weteringpoort was one of the eight Amsterdam city gates that were built during the third and fourth explanations. The Weteringpoort, which was part of the fortifications of Amsterdam, was one of the smaller city gates together with the Raampoort and Zaagmolenpoort.

name: Wiegbrug
en: The Wiegbrug (bridge no. 173) is a movable bridge over the Kostverlorenvaart in Amsterdam-West, connecting the De Clercqstraat with the Admiraal de Ruijterweg. Its name refers to the type of bridge built here in 1904, a rolling bascule bridge.

name: Wil de Graaffbrug
en: The Wil de Graaffbrug (bridge 393) is a pedestrian bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge is located in the northeast of Erasmus Park and spans the Erasmusgracht, which is just outside the park. The bridge extends from the Lof der zotheid bridge (bridge 394). The bridge dates back to 1970, when the park was completely redesigned for a lot of money at the time.

name: Wil de Graaffbrug
en: The Wil de Graaffbrug (bridge 393) is a footbridge in Amsterdam-West. It lies in the north-east of the Erasmuspark and spans the Erasmusgracht, which runs just outside the park, in line with the Lof der zotheidbrug (bridge 394). It dates from 1970, when the park was completely relaid at what was then great expense.

name: Willem de Zwijgerkerk
en: The Willem de Zwijgerkerk is a Protestant church on Olympiaweg in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a "neighborhood church" of the Protestant Church (PKN) in Amsterdam.

name: Willemsbrug
en: The Willemsbrug (bridge 151) is a bridge in Amsterdam-West over the Singelgracht between the Haarlemmerplein and the Nassauplein. This bascule bridge is named after the nearby Willemspoort. The construction of a bridge at this location became necessary after the construction of the Westerkanaal in 1877.

name: Willemsbrug
en: The Willemsbrug (bridge 151) is a bridge in Amsterdam-West over the Singelgracht between the Haarlemmerplein and the Nassauplein. This bascule bridge is named after the nearby Willemspoort. A bridge became necessary here after the Westerkanaal was dug in 1877. The present bridge is a 1925 design by Piet Kramer, built in 1928.

name: Wim Sonneveldbrug
en: The Wim Sonneveldbrug (bridge 175) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Marnixstraat and spans the Leidsegracht. It was placed in 1935/1936 to a plain design by Piet Kramer, with no ornament or sculpture.

name: Wim Suurbierbrug
en: The Wim Suurbierbrug (bridge 2239) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the traffic bridges (the others are for slow traffic) that forms the connection within the Park de Meer neighborhood within the Watergraafsmeer, which rose from the ground here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Wim Suurbierbrug
en: The Wim Suurbierbrug (bridge 2239) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. It is one of the traffic bridges — the others are for slow traffic — within the Park de Meer neighbourhood in the Watergraafsmeer, built here between 1998 and 2002 and entirely surrounded by a ring ditch.

name: Witte Boogbrug
en: The Witte Boogbrug (bridge 469), named after its appearance, is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. It lies in the Monnikendammerweg and spans a local pond. It was built as a viaduct, designed in the mid-1960s as part of the crossing of the Monnikendammerweg and the Zuiderzeeweg.

name: Witte Boogbrug
en: The Witte Boogbrug (bridge 469), named after its appearance, is a work of art in Amsterdam-Noord. It is located on Monnikendammerweg. It spans a local pond. The bridge was built as a viaduct. It was designed in the mid-1960s as part of the intersection of the Monnikendammerweg and the Zuiderzeeweg. This Zuiderzeeweg would pass through the Amsterdamsebrug

name: Yaa Adu-Ampomabrug
en: The Yaa Adu-Ampomabrug, called the Reigersbospadbrug until 2023, is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Zaagpoort
en: The Zaagpoort (bridge no. 161) is a fixed bridge between the center of Amsterdam and the Amsterdam-West district. The bridge connects on the one hand Marnixplein and Marnixstraat on the other hand Frederik Hendrikplantsoen and Nassaukade. It crosses the Singelgracht.

name: Zaagpoort
en: De Zaagpoort (bridge no. 161) is a fixed bridge between the centre of Amsterdam and the Amsterdam-West borough. It connects the Marnixplein and Marnixstraat on one side with the Frederik Hendrikplantsoen and Nassaukade on the other, crossing the Singelgracht. The covered Marnixbad stood beside it before it was demolished and replaced.

name: Zaanlijn
en: The Zaanlijn is the Uitgeest-Amsterdam section of the Den Helder-Amsterdam railway. It runs through the Zaanstreek and takes its name from the fact that much of the line runs parallel to the river Zaan.

name: Zebrabrug
en: The Zebrabrug is a structure in Amsterdam and a temporary structure in Leiden.

name: Zeeburgerbrug
en: The Zeeburgerbrug (no bridge number) is a traffic bridge over the Buiten IJ and Amsterdam-Rhine Canal in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Zeeburgereiland (Amsterdam-Oost) and the Watergraafsmeer. The Zeeburgerbrug carries the A10 with two lanes of three lanes plus two weaving lanes. It is not accessible to pedestrians and cyclists; they must use

name: Zeeburgerbrug
en: The Zeeburgerbrug, which has no bridge number, is a traffic bridge over the Buiten IJ and the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal in Amsterdam, connecting Zeeburgereiland in Amsterdam-Oost with the Watergraafsmeer. It carries the A10 with three lanes plus two weaving lanes each way, and is closed to pedestrians and cyclists.

name: Zeilbrug
en: The Zeilbrug or Zeilstraatbrug (bridge no. 348) is a bridge over the Schinkel in Amsterdam. It connects the Zeilstraat with the Hoofddorpweg, linking Oud-Zuid with the Hoofddorppleinbuurt. Various city documents mention only bridge 348; Zeilbrug was apparently never an official name.

name: Zeilbrug
en: The Zeilbrug or Zeilstraatbrug (bridge no. 348) is a bridge over the Schinkel in Amsterdam. The bridge connects Zeilstraat and Hoofddorpweg and forms a connection between Oud-Zuid and the Hoofddorpplein neighborhood. Various documents from the municipality of Amsterdam only mentioned bridge 348; Sail Bridge was apparently not an official name.

name: Zigeunermonument - Hel en Vuur
en: The Roma memorial Hel en vuur on the Museumplein in Amsterdam is a bronze sculpture of a man, a woman and two children fleeing a flaring fire. It stands on a brick plinth and is 3.50 m high. It was made by the sculptor Heleen Levano, and the text on the plinth comes from a Roma and Sinti prayer for the dead.

name: Zouthavenbrug
en: The Willem Breukerbrug (bridge 2326) is a structure in Amsterdam-Centrum. Until 10 January 2024 it was called the Zouthavenbrug.

name: Zuiderkerk Tower
en: The Zuidertoren is the tower of the Zuiderkerk in Amsterdam.

name: Zuiderzeeweg
en: The Amsterdamsebrug (bridge 54P) is a fixed arch bridge carrying the Zuiderzeeweg over the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal, between the Zeeburgerdijk in Amsterdam-Oost and Zeeburgereiland. Beyond it the road continues on a concrete fixed bridge that curves left onto Zeeburgereiland, followed by the Schellingwouderbrug.
